notes.title: Update 1.1 Release
notes.notes:
Hello,

As most of you know, Prismatix had a lot of issues with its gameplay. I've went and fixed most known problems, as told to me by the community. The gameplay should now be a lot better and most importantly, a lot more enjoyable than before.

Here is a list of everything that has been added or fixed.

Added: 

    Leaderboards button in the main menu
    Game tips at the end of the match


Fixed: 

    Reworked Prism movement
    Floating and spiked platforms spawning after each other
    Light cubes and drones shooting too fast
    Floating platforms falling too fast
    Prism "Super Jump"
    Prism landing on its corners


Prismatix Mobile Version

In the meantime, i've also been working on a mobile port of the game. That will be coming out very soon, and will also be free to download!

Thank you.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello,

After the games succesful launch, a lot of feedback has been given to me about the game and ups and downs. It turned out to have many problems that seemed to have slipped by me.

 Update 1.1

Because of the games many issues, it is my responsibility to fix anything that players feel is wrong with the game. This update which is currently in development, will hopefully try to make the game better by improving on its current problems.

Thank you.
